title: 第3章 为科比出头第4章 暴揍巴爵士
slug: 诸天之百味人生第一千六百二十章
content_zh:
第3章为科比出头
新书求推荐，求收藏，求投资，反正各种求.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
菲尔虽然叫‘禅师’，但可不是没脾气的人，便是乔丹、科比，这种出名的偏执狂都要在他面前服软。
要是一个普通球员在比赛中忽然离场，然后回来就和禅师说要回到场上去，那想屁吃去吧，不把你按在板凳席上坐到哭，他就跟你姓。
可‘华十二’如今顶着的是‘奥尼尔’的身份，做为球队的当家球员、超级巨星，这点排面还是有的。
禅师非但没有生气，反而关心问道：
“沙克，真的没什么事吧？如果你感觉到不舒服，这场比赛可以不用上场，你知道对于球队来说，你的健康才是最重要的！”
‘华十二’露出了一丝笑意，拍了拍禅师的肩膀：“放心吧菲尔，今天水喝多了，刚才是真憋不住了！”
他这话说出来，替补席上瞬间一片笑声。
禅师也从善如流，借着一个死球的机会，直接叫了暂停。
科比下场的时候也对奥胖表示了关心，现在ok组合还处于大杀四方的蜜月期，做为组合中的小老弟，老科还是很关心这个大哥的。
‘华十二’又把之前那番话说了一遍，自然又引起一片笑声。
禅师交代了一番战术，有了‘奥尼尔’的篮球记忆，‘华十二’并不难理解主教练的意图，也听的明白。
等禅师交代完了，然后示意换人，‘埃·斯·格林’下，‘奥尼尔’上。
‘华十二’看了‘埃·斯·格林’一眼，他这个替补可是大大有名，其职业生涯曾连续出场1192场比赛，是nba史上连续出场最多的球员，这也为他赢得了‘铁人’的绰号。
他在16年的职业生涯所经历的1281场比赛里出场了1278场（99.8%）比赛，只缺席了3场，而且缺席的3场都发生在生涯中的第2个赛季。
令人惊奇的是，如此高强度的比赛，其职业生涯却并未遭受过大伤，据坊间传闻与其禁欲三十九年有关，因此被后世的内地球迷称为‘金刚童子身’。
对于刚刚上场就被换下，‘埃·斯·格林’没有任何意见，毕竟他知道谁才是球队老大。
更何况他刚刚在篮下防守的时候，肋骨被上篮的‘巴克利’怼了一肘子，现在还疼着呢，正好下来休息一会。

听到‘奥尼尔’要上场，他大声道：“沙克，打爆他们！”
‘华十二’笑道：“放心吧埃斯，我一定会打爆巴克利那家伙的！”
‘埃·斯·格林’以为‘奥尼尔’看到了‘巴克利’肘自己的那一幕，不由得笑道：“哈哈，就这么干！”
他以为‘奥尼尔’是在说用篮球打爆对方，可实际上‘华十二’说的就是字面上的意思。
就要上场的时候，‘科比’快速走过来拉住‘华十二’，低声道：“沙克，上场之后能不能让我单打对方那个新秀后卫一会儿？”
他说着朝‘马赛克’队那边指了指。
‘华十二’顺着老科的手朝马赛克队那边看去，就看到一个有些眼熟但十分年轻的身影，低声问道：“你说的是弗朗西斯？”
‘科比’点点头道：“对，我要给他一个教训！”
‘华十二’有些好笑，不用想都知道‘弗朗西斯’那家伙肯定是朝‘科比’喷垃圾话了。
你说你喷谁不好，非要喷这个偏执狂，这下子要倒霉了吧。
湖人队如今的进攻战术是以‘奥尼尔’为核心发起低位单打，奥胖没机会才会交给空切的外线，形成三角战术。
刚才禅师布置战术也是这么强调的，所以‘科比’想要持球主攻，给‘弗朗西斯’点教训，还要‘奥尼尔’这个球队老大同意才行。
看着‘科比’眼中那期盼的小眼神，‘华十二’更觉好笑，要是再过几年，老科怕是拿球就干了吧，哪还有这种当小弟的自觉。
这件事若是原来的‘奥尼尔’虽然在这个阶段和老科关系不错，但估计真不会答应对方的要求，因为这场比赛奥胖可是憋着劲要和大梦‘奥拉朱旺’与‘巴克利’两个超级内线较量一番的。
可是现在代替‘奥胖’的是‘华十二’，他可并没有非要统治内线的执念，他的目的不过是揍‘巴克利’一顿而已。
正要开口答应，忽然心中一动想到什么，一把将‘老科’搂过来低头道：
“答应你可以，不过你也得答应我一件事！”

Chapter 3 Stand up for Kobe
I’m looking for recommendations for new books, collections, investments, whatever.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
Although Phil is called "Zen Master", he is not a temperamental person. Even famous paranoias like Jordan and Kobe have to surrender in front of him.
If an ordinary player suddenly leaves the game during the game, and then comes back and tells the Zen Master that he wants to return to the field, then go ahead and eat whatever you want. If he doesn't press you on the bench until you cry, he will take your last name.
But 'Hua Twelve' is now carrying the identity of 'O'Neal'. As the head player and superstar of the team, he still has this status.
Instead of being angry, the Zen master asked with concern:
"Shaq, is everything really okay? If you feel uncomfortable, you don't have to play in this game. You know that for the team, your health is the most important!"
'Hua Twelve' showed a smile and patted the Zen master on the shoulder: "Don't worry Phil, I drank too much water today. I really couldn't hold it in anymore!"
When he said this, the bench burst into laughter.
Zen Master followed suit and took advantage of a dead ball to call a timeout.
Kobe Bryant also expressed concern for O'Pang when he came off the court. Now the OK team is still in the honeymoon period of killing everyone. As the younger brother in the team, Kobe still cares about this big brother.
'Hua Twelve' said what he said before again, which naturally aroused laughter again.
Zen Master explained some tactics, and with ‘O’Neal’s basketball memory, it was not difficult for ‘Hua Twelve’ to understand the coach’s intentions and listen clearly.
After the Zen master finished explaining, he signaled for substitutions, "E.S. Green" exited, "O'Neal" entered.
‘Hua Twelve’ glanced at ‘E.S. Green’. He was a very famous substitute. He had played 1,192 consecutive games in his career, making him the player with the most consecutive appearances in NBA history. This also earned him the nickname ‘Iron Man’.
He played in 1,278 (99.8%) of the 1,281 games he played in his 16-year career, and only missed 3 games, and the 3 missed games all occurred in the second season of his career.
Surprisingly, despite playing such a high-intensity game, he did not suffer any major injuries in his career. According to rumors, it was related to his thirty-nine years of abstinence, so he was called the "King Kong Child Body" by later generations of mainland fans.
'E.S. Green' had no objection to being replaced just after he came on the field. After all, he knew who was the boss of the team.
What's more, when he was defending at the basket, his ribs were elbowed by Barkley who was going up for a layup. It's still hurting now, so he just came down to rest for a while.
When he heard that O'Neal was about to play, he shouted: "Shaq, beat them up!"
'Hua Twelve' smiled and said: "Don't worry Ace, I will definitely beat up that guy Barkley!"
'E.S. Green' thought that 'O'Neal' saw the scene where 'Barkley' elbowed him, and couldn't help laughing: "Haha, just do it!"
He thought 'O'Neal' was talking about beating the opponent with basketball, but in fact 'Hua Twelve' meant it literally.
When he was about to go on the court, 'Kobe' quickly came over and grabbed 'Hua Twelve', and whispered: "Shaq, after I come on the field, can you let me play alone with the opponent's rookie guard for a while?"
He said and pointed towards the 'Mosaic' team.
'Hua Twelve' followed Corvo's hand and looked towards the Mosaic team, and saw a familiar but very young figure, and asked in a low voice: "Are you talking about Francis?"
'Kobe' nodded and said, "Yes, I want to teach him a lesson!"
‘Hua Twelve’ is a bit funny. You don’t need to think about it to know that ‘Francis’ must have been trash-talking ‘Kobe’.
You said it's not good to criticize anyone, but you have to criticize this bigot., I am going to be unlucky now.
The current offensive tactics of the Lakers are to launch low singles with 'O'Neal' as the core. O'Neal will not give it to the outside line who cuts when he has no chance, forming a triangle tactic.
The Zen Master just laid out the tactics with this emphasis, so if 'Kobe' wants to hold the ball and focus on attacking, and teach 'Francis' a lesson, 'O'Neal', the team leader, must agree.
Seeing the expectant look in 'Kobe's' eyes, 'Hua Twelve' felt even more amused. If in a few years, Kobe would just take the ball and do it. How could he still have this kind of consciousness of being a younger brother.
If this matter turns out to be O'Neal, although he has a good relationship with Corvo at this stage, he probably will not agree to the other party's request, because in this game, O'Neal is holding back his energy to compete with the two super insiders of Dream Olajuwon and Barkley.
But now the person who replaces 'O'Fat' is 'Hua Twelve'. He has no obsession with dominating the inside. His purpose is just to beat 'Barkley'.
Just as he was about to agree, something suddenly occurred to his mind. He hugged Corvo and lowered his head and said:
"I can promise you, but you also have to promise me something!"
